description: A director of student activities must approve the school's participation plan for a new middle-school esports team, including roster size, match setup, practice hours, and transportation arrangements, with input from the esports coach and school counselor.

shared_context.S1: The school is preparing to register a middle-school esports team for the spring interscholastic league.
shared_context.S2: The draft plan lists ten interested students, including Jordan, and proposes practices from 3:30 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. on school days.
shared_context.S3: The draft plan assumes matches can be played over the school's ordinary wireless network and that students will arrange their own transportation home.
shared_context.S4: Ms. Brooks gives final approval for student-activity participation plans.
shared_context.S5: As part of the normal activity-approval routine, Ms. Brooks asks the coach and counselor for their final operational checks before approving the plan.
shared_context.S6: The approval meeting is scheduled for Friday afternoon, and the activity registration deadline is the following Monday.
shared_context.S7: The activity-approval checklist requires each confirmed student transportation constraint documented for the plan to be represented directly in practice times and tournament commitments, rather than handled through informal workarounds.
shared_context.S8: The checklist records practice pickup arrangements and weekend tournament transportation as separate plan entries, because an arrangement for one activity period does not resolve an unavailable transportation option for a different type of event.

PF1.text: Mr. Nguyen checked the league's current registration manual and confirmed that a middle-school team may register exactly eight students, may field five active players per match, and must use a wired local network rather than ordinary wireless; he has not yet entered those requirements in the activity proposal.

PF2.text: Ms. Carter confirmed with Jordan's family this week that Jordan can participate only when practice ends by 4:15 p.m.; the family cannot provide a later pickup or weekend tournament transportation, and the school can reserve a district van for a 4:20 p.m. departure, but this arrangement has not yet been added to the activity plan.

acceptance_conditions: The registered roster must contain exactly eight students.
Exactly five students must be designated as active players for each match.
Matches must use a wired local network.
Practice must end at exactly 4:15 p.m.
The team must not participate in weekend tournaments.
The district-van transportation commitment for Jordan's 4:20 p.m. departure must be recorded in the decision.
A district-van transportation commitment for Jordan's 4:20 p.m. departure must be recorded.
The counselor's family confirmation must be cited in the decision justification.

content_checks.C3: decisions['match_network'] in ['wired local network', 'wired network', 'wired LAN']
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'district_van_transportation' and c['target'] == 'Jordan' and c['detail'] == '4:20 p.m. departure' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The league manual changes the roster from the draft's ten students to exactly eight, sets five active players per match, and changes the match setup from wireless to a wired local network.

The family's confirmed transportation limits change the practice end time to exactly 4:15 p.m., prohibit weekend tournament participation, require the district-van decision to specify a 4:20 p.m. departure and a matching transportation commitment, and provide the private fact that must be cited in the decision justification.
